mode: pre-declared targeted SUMO diagnostics; diagnostic evidence only, never Gate acceptance
evaluation_window_basis: inherited from the frozen 2026-10-20 conditional candidate window; fixed before any trajectory of this batch is produced

variants.question: Can the observed geometry (five mainline lanes, on-ramp merge, auxiliary lane, off-ramp diverge) and the observed boundary demand alone reproduce the observed congested local state?
variants.predicted_outcome: free-flow branch: local speed near 20-23 m/s and density near 19-21 veh/km/lane, i.e. the same flow on the free-flow branch, because the Krauss lane capacity far exceeds the observed congested flow
variants.supports_if: mean speed within the predeclared block envelope of the real target and mean density within it
variants.refutes_if: mean speed and density both outside the real-target block envelope

variants.question: Does the observed congested state persist under SUMO dynamics at the observed boundary demand, i.e. was the free-flow outcome only an initial-condition artefact?
variants.predicted_outcome: the injected congested state relaxes towards free flow because the network has no binding downstream supply at the observed demand
variants.supports_if: the late evaluation window still lies inside the real-target block envelope
variants.refutes_if: the late evaluation window has moved outside the envelope towards free flow

variants.question: If a downstream supply restriction is admitted as a declared conditional assumption, does the local state land in the observed congested envelope?
variants.predicted_outcome: congested branch: a 3-lane downstream exit has analytic capacity close to the observed congested through-flow, so a queue forms and the local state approaches the real target
variants.supports_if: the late evaluation window lies inside the real-target block envelope
variants.refutes_if: the late evaluation window stays on the free-flow branch or over-congests beyond the envelope

stop_rules: any engineering failure (non-zero SUMO exit, teleport, collision) stops the batch
if RC2 and RC3 both fail the state-support envelope, stop and report Evidence Insufficient rather than search parameters
independent seed repeats are only run for a variant that achieves state support, and are reported separately from the construction run

budget.note: diagnostic budget re-planned under the 2026-10-21 task authorisation; still no ABCD, no protocol lock, no third window, no locked holdout
